title.en: An Act Providing For the Change of Status of the Lopez National High School of Lopez, Fourth District of Quezon, From National High School To National Comprehensive High School, To Be Known As the Lopez National Comprehensive High School, and Appropriating Funds For the Operation and Maintenance Thereof

text.en: The Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall cause the change of status of the Lopez National High School in the Municipality of Lopez, Fourth District of Quezon, from national high school to national comprehensive high school.
The subject school shall be known as the Lopez National Comprehensive High School.

The amount necessary for the implementation of this Act shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Lopez National High School. Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for its operation and maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect immediately upon its approval.
